liquidity_notes.new_derivatives_access: Gate Futures launched PAIR perpetuals at 11:00 UTC with 1x-10x leverage plus bot and copy trading. This listing predated the 13:14 UTC alert and therefore is contextual evidence only, not a post-alert catalyst.

interpretation: PAIR failed to sustain the alert-time price over the first ~1 hour and is materially below the same-day ATH. This is an adverse early persistence result. The still-extreme 24h/7d gains and elevated turnover mean the broader PAIR sub-regime is not invalidated, but no positive leadership upgrade is warranted from this outcome alone.
prospective_scoring_note: Do not retroactively credit the Gate Futures listing as a post-alert catalyst because it launched before the original observation timestamp.
